auth_details: API token via Authorization: Bearer (preferred): generate at Settings → API → Generate New Token (KAGGLE_API_TOKEN env, ~/.kaggle/access_token, or OAuth via `kaggle auth login`). Legacy: username + key Basic Auth from Settings → Create Legacy API Key (kaggle.json).
resolution_notes: auth.details: auditor correct. Official kaggle-cli README and kagglehub distinguish current API tokens (Generate New Token → KAGGLE_API_TOKEN / ~/.kaggle/access_token / OAuth) from legacy username/key in kaggle.json via Create Legacy API Key. https://github.com/Kaggle/kaggle-cli/blob/main/docs/README.md and https://github.com/Kaggle/kagglehub. example.request: auditor correct. Entry’s -u username:key Basic Auth is the legacy path; current token auth uses Authorization: Bearer. Prefer Bearer example per official token flow. https://github.com/Kaggle/kaggle-cli/blob/main/docs/README.md
